title: ERC-8004 registration file with the AIP extension
description: The document an ERC-8004 agentURI resolves to. The ERC-8004 fields are normative in EIP-8004; this schema restates them so a card can be validated in one pass, and adds the x-aip extension for what ERC-8004 has no place for.

type.description: ERC-8004 schema discriminator. A reader MUST NOT interpret a file whose type it does not recognise.

name.description: Free-form in ERC-8004. A2A, MCP, DID, web, ENS, email and OASF are the conventional values.

x402Support.description: ERC-8004 native. Set it rather than duplicating the fact in x-aip.

agentRegistry.description: Lowercase, matching the did:aip v2 identifier form.

aipExtension.description: What ERC-8004 has no field for. A reader that does not recognise `type` MUST ignore this whole object rather than guess at its shape.

type.description: Self-describing, mirroring ERC-8004's own approach. A future v2 changes this string; readers dispatch on it.

agentType.description: Carried over from the on-chain AgentType enum. LLM: general reasoning. Task: a fixed capability set. Execution: takes actions with side effects.

slug.description: The owner-scoped identifier from the Solana registry. ERC-8004 identifies agents by an incrementing tokenId, so this is a display and lookup alias only — it is NOT an identifier and MUST NOT be used as one. Two agents may carry the same slug.

agentVersion.description: The agent's own version. Distinct from services[].version, which versions a protocol.

capabilities.description: The on-chain record capped this at 8 to fit a fixed account size. That constraint is gone; 64 is a sanity bound, not a protocol limit.

id.description: Dotted lowercase, e.g. text.summarize. This is what a caller names in an A2A task request.

amount.description: Decimal string, in whole token units. A string rather than a number because JSON numbers are IEEE 754 doubles and money must not round.

token.description: ERC-20 contract address, lowercase. USDC on Arc is 0x3600000000000000000000000000000000000000.

network.description: CAIP-2. The predecessor used the literal string "solana", which named a chain family rather than a chain.
